Disable Yearly Developer Gifts.Description: This setting will disable the mod developer gifts you will receive yearly. By default, you will receive a yearly randomized gift from myself :-)

Fishing Difficulty.Description: Select a difficulty setting for the fishing minigame. Easy Settings: Decrease difficulty by 5% to 100%, and include a Super Easy Fishing option. Please note; The Super Easy; Max Fish Bar & Buff option will also increase the fishing level with a buff, this will also increase the chances certain fish can spawn. This enhancement will be particularly beneficial for players aiming to collect fishing treasure chests and grant full fishing xp. Easy Sunday Fishing: Decrease difficulty by 10% to 50% on Sundays only. Hard Settings: Increase difficulty by 5% to 100% with a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge! Scroll down for additional options.

Randomized Difficulty.Description: When the Fishing Difficulty setting is active, the difficulty of catching fish will vary within the chosen range. For example, setting the difficulty to 25% Easier means each day, fish will be between 0% and 25% easier to catch. One day, they might be 17% easier, and the next day, 23% easier. This setting is compatible with the Easy, Easy Sunday, and Hard Fishing Difficulty options. However, it does NOT work with the Super Easy and NIGHTMARE options!

All Times Of Day.Description: All fish are now catchable at any time of day.

All Types Of Weather.Description: All fish, except legendary fish, can now be caught in all types of weather.

All Seasons.Description: All fish, except legendary fish, can now be caught in every season.

Same Spawn Rates.Description: All fish, except legendary fish, now share the same spawn rates.

Cave/Mine Fish Availability.Description: The rare cave and mine fish; Stonefish, Ice Pip, and Lava Eel are now available in specific locations. Must be Fishing Level 5. Stonefish; Mountain, Ice Pip; Forest Lake, Lava Eel; Desert. Choose a spawn rate for the fish. Ranges from 1% to 50% chance. Scroll down to see more options.

Night Market Fish Availability.Description: The Night Market Fish (Midnight Squid, Spook Fish, and Blobfish) will now be fishable anywhere on the Beach during Winter after 5pm. Must be Fishing level 5. The All Times Of Day and All Seasons settings will also have an effect on these fish.

Fishable Prize Tickets.Description: Prize Tickets are now a fishable item. Similar to Seaweed and Algae (No minigame). Select a spawn rate ranging from a 1% to 50% chance. Scroll down for additional options.

Clean Waters/No Trash.Description: Select a setting to remove or replace all trash items while fishing. No Trash: Disables trash while fishing entirely. Crab Pot Fish: Replaces trash items with crab pot fish during fishing. Note that occasional trash items may still be fished up. Trash serves as a fallback if no fish spawn, but these settings significantly reduce trash chances.
Clean Waters/No Trash.AllowValues: Default, No Trash, Crab Pot Fish

Clean Waters/No Weeds.Description: Select a setting to remove or replace Seaweed, Green Algae, and White Algae while fishing. No Weeds and Algae: Disables all weeds and algae while fishing entirely. Crab Pot Fish: Replaces seaweed and algae with any crab pot fish during fishing.
Clean Waters/No Weeds.AllowValues: Default, No Weeds and Algae, Crab Pot Fish

Iridium Rod Attach. Slots.Description: Select how many attachment slots are available on the Iridium Rod. Default is 1. This will allow you to stack bobber and lure effects. Please note, this will only apply to newly acquired Iridium Rods after the setting is enabled, you may have to repurchase a rod! Ranges from 2 to 10 extra slots, each selection also accounts for there being 1 bait slot. Please note, this will only apply to newly acquired Iridium Rods after the setting is enabled! Also note, adding extra slots may cause the slot graphics to go outside the info box. This will not have any effect on the game. Scroll down to see additional options.

Adv. Iridium Rod Attach. Slots.Description: Select how many attachment slots are available on the Advanced Iridium Rod. Default is 3. This will allow you to stack bobber and lure effects. Ranges from 3 to 10 extra attachment slots, each selection also accounts for there being 1 bait slot. Please note, this will only apply to newly acquired Advanced Iridium Rods after the setting is enabled! Also note, adding extra slots may cause the slot graphics to go outside the info box. This will not have any effect on the game. Scroll down to see additional options.

Crab Pots Same Spawn Rates.Description: Crab Pot fish will now all share the same spawn rates. Does not apply to the Jellies and Bug Meat settings below!

Crab Pots No Trash.Description: Crab Pots will no longer yield trash items.

Crab Pots Jellies.Description: Crab Pots now spawn Jellies. This includes River, Sea, and Cave Jellies. If using the Lookup Anything and/or Stardew Progress mods, this will also remove the jellies from the fish collections tab. This is due to a bug in game but this will not have any negative impacts on existing playthroughs if completing the fish collection! It will simply remove the jelly entries and the collection will still be completable!

Crab Pots Bug Meat.Description: Crab Pots now spawn Bug Meat. Choose whether they can spawn in freshwater (rivers and lakes) or the ocean (beach).

Jelly Spawn Rates.Description: Select a setting to determine the spawn rates of all jellies while fishing. Ranges from a 1% to 50% chance or remove jellies altogether. The Default 10% chance has them in the same pool as normal fish so they're more rare than stated. Selecting 10% in the options will be a 'true' 10% chance to spawn jellies instead of using the default method. All other spawn settings will also put the jellies in their own spawn pool. Using this setting also removes the luck chance boost. Scroll down for additional options.

Recycling Machine Tackle.Description: Recycling Machines will now occasionally yield fishing tackle from all trash items.

Recycling Prismatic Shards.Description: Recycling Machines now have a slight chance of yielding a Prismatic Shard from trash items.

Fish Smoker Faster.Description: Reduce the production time for Fish Smokers, with options ranging from 40 minutes to 10 minutes.

Fish Smoker Materials.Description: Reduce the material requirements for crafting Fish Smokers.

Fish Smoker No Coal.Description: Fish Smokers will no longer require coal to produce smoked fish.

Fish Smoker Quality.Description: Select the quality of smoked fish produced by Fish Smokers.
Fish Smoker Quality.AllowValues: Default (No Quality), Gold Quality, Iridium Quality

Fish Smoker Produce Min.Description: Select the minimum daily production of smoked fish from Fish Smokers, with a range spanning from 2 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Smoker Produce Max.Description: Select the maximum daily production of smoked fish from Fish Smokers, with a range spanning from 2 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Smoker Required Mats..Description: Select the amount of fish required to be placed inside Fish Smokers. Default is 1. Scroll down for additional options.

Bait Maker Materials.Description: Reduce the material requirements for crafting Bait Makers.

Bait Maker Produce Min.Description: Select the minimum daily production of bait from Bait Makers, with a range spanning from 6 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.

Bait Maker Produce Max.Description: Select the maximum daily production of bait from Bait Makers, with a range spanning from 11 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.

Bait Maker Required Mats..Description: Select the amount of fish required to be placed inside Bait Makers. Default is 1. Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Shop Open All Days.Description: Willy’s Fishing Shop will now remain open every day, except during special event days.

Crab Pot Price.Description: Select the price of Crab Pots at Willy’s Fish Shop. The available range spans from 1g to 3000g. Default is 1500. Scroll down for additional options.

All Fishing Rods Immediately.Description: All Fishing Rods will now be offered for sale immediately at Willy's Fish Shop.

Adv. Iridium Fish Rod Avail..Description: The Advanced Iridium Fishing Rod will now be offered for sale at Willy's Fish Shop. You can decide whether to make it available Immediately or at Fishing Level 10 rather than having achieved fishing mastery.

All Fishing Rod Prices.Description: Select the price of the Iridium Fishing Rod at Willy’s Fish Shop. The available range spans from 25% to 100% cheaper, or from 25% to 100% more expensive. Scroll down for additional options.
All Fishing Rod Prices.AllowValues: Default, 25% Cheaper, 50% Cheaper, 75% Cheaper, 99% Cheaper, 25% More Expensive, 50% More Expensive, 75% More Expensive, 100% More Expensive

Fish Shop Curiosity/Quality.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells the Curiosity and Quality lures for sale. These lures become available once you reach Fishing Level 9. This setting is affected by the All Tackle Immediately setting.

All Tackle Immediately.Description: All tackle is now available for sale at Willy’s Fish Shop immediately and no longer dependent on fishing level.

Fish Shop Tackle Prices.Description: Select the sale price of all lures at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 25% to 99% cheaper, or from 25% to 100% more expensive. Scroll down for additional options.
Fish Shop Tackle Prices.AllowValues: Default, 25% Cheaper, 50% Cheaper, 75% Cheaper, 99% Cheaper, 25% More Expensive, 50% More Expensive, 75% More Expensive, 100% More Expensive

Fish Shop Seafoam Pudding.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells the Seafoam Pudding food item. You can decide whether to make it available Immediately or at Fishing Level 9.

Fish Shop Seafoam P Price.Description: Select the sale price of the Seafoam Pudding food item at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 1g to 5000g. Default is 5000g. Please note that the Fish Shop Seafoam Pudding setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Shop Worm Bin.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells Worm Bins. This setting is essential for configuring the Worm Bin Price setting below!
Fish Shop Worm Bin.AllowValues: Default, Immediately, Fishing Level 4, Fishing Level 3, Fishing Level 2, Fishing Level 1

Fish Shop Worm Bin Price.Description: Select the sale price of the Worm Bin at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 1g to 5000g. Default is 5000g. Please note that the Fish Shop Worm Bin setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Shop Deluxe Worm Bin.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells Deluxe Worm Bins. This setting is essential for configuring the Deluxe Worm Bin Price setting below!
Fish Shop Deluxe Worm Bin.AllowValues: Default, Immediately, Fishing Level 8, Fishing Level 6, Fishing Level 4, Fishing Level 2, Fishing Level 1

Fish Shop Deluxe Worm Bin Price.Description: Select the sale price of the Deluxe Worm Bin at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 1g to 10000g. Default is 10000g. Please note that the Fish Shop Deluxe Worm Bin setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Shop Bait Maker.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells Bait Makers. This setting is essential for configuring the Bait Maker Price setting below!

Fish Shop Bait Maker Price.Description: Select the sale price of the Bait Maker at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 1g to 10000g. Default is 10000g. Please note that the Fish Shop Bait Maker setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Shop Recycle Machine.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells Recycling Machines. This setting is essential for configuring the Recycling Machine Price setting below!
Fish Shop Recycle Machine.AllowValues: Default, Immediately, Fishing Level 4, Fishing Level 3, Fishing Level 2, Fishing Level 1

Fish Shop Recycle Machine Price.Description: Select the sale price of the Recycling Machine at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 1g to 3000g. Default is 3000g. Please note that the Fish Shop Recycle Machine setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.

Fish Shop Fish Smoker.Description: Willy’s Fish Shop now sells Fish Smokers. This setting is essential for configuring the Fish Smoker Price setting below!

Fish Shop Fish Smoker Price.Description: Select the sale price of the Fish Smoker at Willy’s Fish Shop. This range spans from 1g to 20000g. Default is 20000g. Please note that the Fish Shop Fish Smoker setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.
